text: Main SBI bank se bol raha hoon. Aapka account band ho jayega agar aaj hi KYC update nahi kiya. Turant OTP bhejiye verification ke liye.
Main CBI se bol raha hoon, aapke naam pe money laundering ka case file hua hai. Kisi ko mat batana, ye confidential matter hai. Call mat kaatiye, line par rahiye.
Aapka parcel customs me atka hai. Is UPI id pe Rs.2500 bhej dijiye, refund ho jayega. Warna parcel wapas chala jayega aaj hi.
Sir aapka bijli connection abhi kat jayega. Bill update nahi hua hai. Turant is number pe call kariye 8765432109 aur AnyDesk app install kar lijiye.
Badhai ho! Aapne Rs.10,00,000 ka lucky draw jeeta hai. Prize money claim karne ke liye processing fee Rs.4999 bhejiye aur apna bank account number aur OTP share kariye.
